blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generalizable AI-generated video detection remains challenging because natural motion and content variations can resemble synthesis artifacts, making isolated video discrepancies unreliable indicators of authenticity. To address this challenge, we propose Spatial and Contextual Reference-informed Detection (SCRiD), a framework that interprets video variations through complementary spatial and contextual references. Specifically, we introduce Matched-Coordinate Residual Response (MCR) to characterize temporal residual associations under motion and coordinate references with matched subpixel sampling conditions. We further develop Real-Conditioned Score Adaptation (RCSA), which learns a content-conditioned denoising reference from authentic videos and probes its responses across multiple noise scales and quality views to guide feature adaptation. To integrate these complementary sources of evidence, we design Reversible Evidence Exchange (REE) to enable information exchange through reversible symplectic updates. We train SCRiD using synthetic videos from only 4 generators and evaluate it across 88 generator or task subsets spanning 6 benchmarks. Our method achieves average ACC and AP of 72.72% and 74.23%, respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 3.24 and 0.81 percentage points.Ablation and robustness experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed components and the stability of SCRiD under common post-processing operations.
blocks.zh: 一般的AI生成的视频检测仍然具有挑战性,因为自然运动和内容变化可以类似于合成文物,使得孤立的视频差异不可靠的真实性指标. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用空间和背景参考信息检测(SCRID)这一框架,通过互补的空间和背景参考来解释视频变化。 具体地说,我们引入了匹配-协调残余反应(MCR),以描述运动下的时间残留关联,并协调与匹配的子像素采样条件的参考. 我们进一步发展Real-Contestioned Score Reformation(RCSA),从真实视频中学习到一个内容条件化的去诺参考,并探索其在多个噪声尺度和质量视角中的反应,以指导特征适应. 为了整合这些补充证据来源,我们设计了可逆转证据交换(REE),以便通过可逆转的同义更新来进行信息交流. 我们只使用4个发电机的合成视频来训练SCRID, 并且通过88个发电机或超过6个基准的任务子集来评价它。 我们的方法使ACC和AP的平均成绩分别达到72.72%和74.23%,比最强的基准高出3.24和0.81个百分点。 在共同的后处理业务中,对拟议部件的有效性和SCRID的稳定性进行了进一步验证。

blocks.en: Modern video generation models produce increasingly realistic synthetic videos [ 3 , 37 ] , offering substantial creative potential. However, they also make it hard for humans to verify the authenticity of visual media, posing serious security risks, such as misinformation spread, public opinion manipulation, etc. Consequently, developing reliable, generalizable AI-generated video detectors has become highly urgent yet challenging, since generalizable AI-generated video detection requires a detector trained on samples from a limited set of generators to recognize videos produced by unseen ones [ 36 ] . Existing approaches have explored various sources of detection evidence. Frame-level methods [ 25 , 29 ] identify synthesis-related spatial and frequency artifacts or leverage pretrained visual encoders to extract transferable representations [ 23 , 2 ] . Video-level methods [ 21 , 4 , 39 ] further exploit temporal information by analyzing inter-frame differences, motion patterns, and higher-order dynamics. Although these advances have broadened the range of cues available for distinguishing real and generated videos, such methods also capture natural variations in authentic videos, making synthesis-related discrepancies harder to distinguish when facing unseen generators.
blocks.zh: 现代视频生成模型制作出越来越现实的合成视频[3,37],提供了巨大的创作潜力. 然而,它们也使人类难以验证视觉媒体的真实性,造成严重的安全风险,如错误信息传播,舆论操纵等. 因此,开发可靠、通俗易懂的AI生成的视频探测器已变得非常紧迫而具有挑战性,因为通俗易懂的AI生成的视频探测器需要用有限的发电机组的样本来培训检测器,以识别由看不见的发电机产生的视频[36] 。 现有方法探索了各种探测证据来源。 框架级方法[25,29] 确定与合成有关的空间和频率文物或利用预先训练过的视觉编码器提取可转移的表示 [23,2]. 视频级方法[21, 4, 39]通过分析帧间差异,运动规律,和更高顺序动态,进一步利用了时间信息. 虽然这些进步扩大了用于区分真实和生成的视频的提示范围,但是这些方法也捕捉了真实视频中的自然变化,使得在面对看不见的生成者时,合成相关差异更难区分.

blocks.en: Natural video often contains rapid motion, camera movements, rich textures, and changing illumination, all of which can produce pronounced residuals and feature variations without any synthesis [ 19 , 27 ] . Meanwhile, generated videos may exhibit plausible appearances and smooth temporal transitions, leaving only subtle irregularities that are difficult to recognize [ 12 ] . As a result, a large discrepancy does not necessarily indicate synthesis, while a small discrepancy does not guarantee authenticity. Moreover, synthesis artifacts may vary considerably across generators [ 20 ] , limiting the reliability of patterns learned from known generation methods. These difficulties suggest that the significance of an observed discrepancy cannot be determined by its magnitude alone, but also depends on how it relates to natural changes in video content. Distinguishing such natural variations from synthesis-related irregularities remains a central challenge for generalized video detection.
blocks.zh: 自然视频往往包含快速运动,相机运动,丰富的纹理,以及不断变化的发光等,所有发光的发光都能够产生显出后遗症和特征变化而没有任何合成[19,27]. 与此同时,制作的视频可能呈现出可信的外表和平稳的时间过渡,只留下难以识别的微妙违规行为。 因此,大相差并不一定表示合成,而小相差并不能保证真实性. 此外,合成文物在发电机中可能有很大差异[20],限制了从已知生成方法中汲取的规律的可靠性。 这些困难表明,所观察到的差异的意义不能仅由它的规模决定,而且还取决于它与视频内容的自然变化的关系。 将这种自然变化与合成违规区分开来,仍然是普遍视频探测的主要挑战。

blocks.en:
As objects move across frames, their residual patterns shift accordingly, making comparisons at fixed image locations sensitive to natural motion.
As shown in Figure 1 (a), we observe that the same residual signals from paired generated and real videos exhibit different discriminative responses when compared at motion-corresponding locations and at nearby positions in the initial image coordinates. Moreover, these discriminative cues become weaker when the motion correspondence is disrupted. These observations indicate that the discriminative value of temporal residuals depends not only on their magnitude, but also on the spatial correspondence used to associate them across frames.
Moreover, spatial correspondence only tells us where to compare residuals, leaving open whether the observed changes are consistent with the surrounding video content. A local feature may change naturally alongside related changes in other regions and frames, making it difficult to judge its significance in isolation. As illustrated in Figure 1 (b), we observe that even when the local feature variation is held fixed, the denoising response depends on the surrounding content: when changes in surrounding regions and frames are consistent with the local variation, the remaining denoising response is smaller, whereas disrupting this relationship leads to a larger response. This observation indicates that the significance of local feature variations also depends on how well they agree with changes in the surrounding content. Together, these findings suggest that identifying synthesis-related discrepancies requires considering both the spatial correspondence of temporal residuals and the contextual consistency of feature variations.

如图1(a)所显示的,我们看到,从成对生成的和真实的视频中发出的相同剩余信号,在运动对应地点和相邻位置的初始图像坐标上,显示出不同的歧视反应。 此外,当动议书信中断时,这些歧视性提示会变得更弱. 这些意见表明,时间残存物的区别价值不仅取决于其规模,还取决于用于将它们跨框架联系起来的空间通信.
此外,空间通信只告诉我们在哪里比较残存,留下观察的变化是否与周围的视频内容一致的空洞. 地方特征可能与其他区域和框架的相关变化一道自然而然地发生变化,因此很难孤立地判断其意义。 如图1(b)所显示,我们观察到,即使局部特征变异被固定,去诺反应也取决于周围内容:当周边地区和框架的变化与局部变异一致时,剩下的去诺反应较小,而破坏这种关系则导致更大的反应. 这一观察表明,局部特征变化的意义还取决于它们是否同意周围内容的变化。 这些调查结果表明,要确定与综合有关的差异,既需要考虑时间残存的空间对应关系,也需要考虑特征变化的背景一致性。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these findings, we propose Spatial and Contextual Reference-informed Detection (SCRiD), a framework that identifies synthesis-related irregularities by examining how video changes behave under complementary reference conditions. Specifically, we introduce Matched-Coordinate Residual Response (MCR) to compare inter-frame residual associations along estimated motion and at nearby positions in the initial image coordinates. By matching their subpixel sampling conditions and measuring relative correlation and distance responses, we extract local temporal evidence that reflects inter-frame spatial correspondence. To further account for content-dependent variations, we develop Real-Conditioned Score Adaptation (RCSA) to learn a content-conditioned denoising reference from authentic videos. We then probe this reference through symmetric perturbations across multiple noise levels and quality views and use the resulting responses to adapt pretrained visual representations. Since these two components provide different types of evidence, we introduce Reversible Evidence Exchange (REE) to enable their interaction before fusion. Specifically, we maintain the two evidence streams as coupled states and exchange information through reversible, symplectic updates which can preserve the recoverability of their joint representation throughout the interaction stage. The exchanged representations are subsequently fused and aggregated for video-level classification.
Extensive experiments on 6 benchmarks, including GenVidBench [ 22 ] , AIGVDBench [ 20 ] , ComGenVid [ 1 ] , GenBuster [ 34 ] , ViF-Bench [ 16 ] , and RA-Bench [ 18 ] , demonstrate that SCRiD achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse datasets and generation sources when trained exclusively on GenVidBench Pair1.

基于这些调查结果,我们提议采用空间和背景参考信息检测(SCRID)这一框架,通过审查视频变化在补充参考条件下的表现,查明与综合有关的违规行为。 具体地说,我们引入了相匹配-相协调残余反应(MCR),以便按照估计的运动和在图像坐标上附近的位置比较框架间残余关联。 通过匹配它们的子像素采样条件并测量相对相关性和相距反应,我们提取出反映帧间空间对应的局部时间证据. 为了进一步说明内容依赖性的变化,我们开发了Real-Contitioned Score Reformation(RCSA),从正版视频中学习内容有条件的去诺参考. 然后,我们通过对称的扰动在多层噪声和质量视图中探寻这一参考,并利用由此产生的反应来适应预先训练的视觉表现. 由于这两个组成部分提供了不同类型的证据,我们引入了可逆证据交换(REE),以便在聚变前能够进行相互作用. 具体地说,我们保持了两个证据流的组合状态,并通过可逆的、协同的更新交换信息,在整个互动阶段能够保持其联合代表的可恢复性。 交换的表述随后相接并汇总,以便进行视频级别分类。
关于6个基准的广泛实验,包括GenVid Bench [22],AIGVDBench [20],ComGenVid [1],GenBuster [34],ViF-Bench [16],以及RA-Bench [18],证明SCRID在专门接受GenVid Bench Pair1的培训时,在不同的数据集和生成源上都实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Overall, our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We highlight the importance of spatial correspondence and contextual consistency in interpreting video discrepancies, providing a new perspective for generalized AI-generated video detection. • We propose SCRiD, a reference-informed detection framework that combines matched-coordinate residual evidence with real-conditioned denoising responses and enables their interaction through reversible evidence exchange. • Extensive experiments across 6 benchmarks demonstrate the strong generalization capability of SCRiD, outperforming existing detectors on diverse unseen generators and datasets.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: AI-Generated Video Detection. AI-generated video detection has evolved from frame-level synthesis trace analysis [ 15 , 29 , 23 ] toward explicit temporal modeling. DeCoF [ 21 ] examines frame consistency, DeMamba [ 4 ] models spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and D3 [ 39 ] exploits higher-order temporal variations without training. However, generalization to unseen generators remains challenging, as natural motion and content variations can resemble synthesis artifacts [ 30 ] . Recent methods address this challenge through forensic augmentation [ 5 ] or spatial and temporal likelihoods derived from real videos [ 1 ] . Despite these advances, distinguishing synthesis artifacts from natural video variations remains difficult. Our SCRiD complements these approaches by interpreting video discrepancies under spatial and contextual references and integrating complementary evidence for generalizable detection.
blocks.zh: AI-Generated 视频检测. AI生成的视频探测从帧级合成微量分析[15,29,23]演变为明确的时间模型. DeCoF [21] 考察了帧一致性,DeMamba [4] 模型空间和时间不一致,而D3 [39] 利用更高顺序的时间变化而不经过培训. 然而,对无形发电机的通俗化仍然具有挑战性,因为自然运动和内容变化可能类似于合成文物[30]。 最近的方法通过法证增强[5]或从真实视频中获得的空间和时间可能性来应对这一挑战[1]. 尽管取得了这些进展,但将合成文物与自然视频变化区分开来仍然很困难. 我们的SCRID通过在空间和背景参考资料下解释视频差异并综合补充证据进行一般性检测来补充这些方法。

blocks.en:
Temporal Consistency Modeling. Analyzing temporal consistency helps detect video forgeries by revealing artifacts that may be overlooked when frames are examined in isolation.
STIL [ 7 ] captures spatiotemporal inconsistencies through adjacent-frame differences. FTCN [ 40 ] models temporal coherence using convolutional features. AltFreezing [ 33 ] encourages the learning of both spatial and temporal artifacts. Kim et al. [ 13 ] explore pixel-wise temporal frequency patterns to identify subtle manipulations. Recent studies extend temporal analysis to fully AI-generated videos. ReStraV [ 11 ] characterizes temporal trajectories in pretrained feature spaces, while MotionPhys [ 9 ] investigates the physical consistency of optical-flow trajectories. These studies highlight the importance of temporal dynamics in detecting synthetic content.
Our SCRiD examines residual associations under motion-aligned and image-coordinate references to characterize how spatial correspondence affects the discriminative value of temporal residuals.

blocks.en: Visual Prior Representation. Pretrained visual encoders provide transferable representations that can reduce dependence on generator-specific artifacts. DINOv2 [ 24 ] learns general-purpose visual features through self-supervised pretraining, while RealForensics [ 8 ] leverages authentic videos to learn representations for robust forgery detection. Another line of research exploits reconstruction-based cues to distinguish real and generated content. DIRE [ 32 ] measures reconstruction errors from pretrained diffusion models, whereas AEROBLADE [ 26 ] examines the reconstruction behavior of latent-diffusion autoencoders. Beyond reconstruction, denoising score matching [ 31 , 28 ] offers a principled way to characterize data distributions through noise-dependent responses. These studies highlight the potential of pretrained representations and learned data priors for visual analysis. Building on these ideas, our SCRiD learns a content-conditioned denoising reference from authentic videos and probes its responses across multiple noise levels and quality views. The resulting responses guide representation adaptation to provide contextual evidence that complements temporal residual information.
blocks.zh: 视觉前代表。 预先训练的视觉编码器提供可转移的表示,可以减少对生成器特定文物的依赖. DINOv2 [24] 通过自我监督的预训来学习通用视觉特征,而Real Forensics [8] 利用正版视频来学习表现来进行强力伪造检测. 另一行研究利用基于重建的提示来区分真实和生成的内容. DIRE [32] 测量来自预受训练的传播模型的重建错误,而AEROBLADE [26] 则检查了潜在扩散自编码器的重建行为. 除了重建外,对[31,28]的比分进行点名,提供了一个原则性的方法,通过依赖噪音的响应来描述数据分布. 这些研究突出了预先训练的表述和学习到的数据前科对视觉分析的潜力. 根据这些想法,我们的SCRID从真实的视频中学习到一个内容有条件的去诺语参考,并探究它在多个噪音级别和质量视图中的反应. 由此产生的答复指导了对表述方式的调整,以提供背景证据,补充时间遗留信息。

blocks.en: Given an input video X = { x t } t = 1 T X=\{x_{t}\}^{T}_{t=1} with T T frames, SCRiD aims to distinguish authentic from AI-generated videos and generalize to unseen generators. SCRiD approaches this goal by interpreting video variations under two complementary references: 1) spatial correspondence, which determines where temporal residuals should be compared, and 2) content-dependent temporal consistency, which characterizes how local feature variations relate to their surrounding context. These references are modeled by Matched-Coordinate Residual Response (MCR) and Real-Conditioned Score Adaptation (RCSA), respectively. Their resulting representations are subsequently integrated through Reversible Evidence Exchange (REE) for video-level prediction. The overall architecture of SCRiD is illustrated in Figure. 2 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets and Evaluation Protocols. We evaluate SCRiD on 6 benchmarks covering 88 generator or task subsets: GenVidBench [ 22 ] , AIGVDBench [ 20 ] , ComGenVid [ 1 ] , GenBuster [ 34 ] , ViF-Bench [ 16 ] , and RA-Bench [ 18 ] . Following the GenVidBench-143k protocol, we train exclusively on Pair1 containing authentic videos and synthetic videos from 4 generators, and evaluate on Pair2 with 4 unseen generators. We further assess cross-dataset generalization on AIGVDBench, ComGenVid, GenBuster, and ViF-Bench, and examine detection performance in realistic crisis scenarios on RA-Bench. We report video-level accuracy (ACC) and average precision (AP).
blocks.zh: 数据集和评价协议。 我们根据涉及88个生成器或任务子集的6个基准对SCRID进行评价: GenVid Bench [22],AIGVDBench [20],ComGenVid [1],GenBuster [34],ViF-Bench [16],和RA-Bench [18]. 根据GenVid Bench-143k协议,我们专门在Pair1上进行训练,其中包括4个发电机的正版视频和合成视频,并在Pair2上用4个看不见的发电机进行评价. 我们进一步评估AIGVDBench、ComGenVid、GenBuster和ViF-Bench的跨数据集概括,并审查RA-Bench在现实危机情况下的检测性能。 我们报告视频的准确度(ACC)和平均精确度(AP)。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We use DINOv2 ViT-S/14 [ 24 ] as the backbone and train the student’s last 2 Transformer blocks while freezing the teacher and shared backbone. We uniformly sample 8 frames per video from an approximately 2-second central segment and construct 224 × 224 224\times 224 global and local views. DIS [ 14 ] is used to estimate Optical flow, and MCR uses a coordinate offset radius of r = 1 r=1 pixel. We train SCRiD with consistent horizontal flipping and mild brightness augmentation for 10 epochs on an NVIDIA L20 GPU using AdamW with a batch size of 16, weight decay of 0.01, and cosine learning rate decay. Learning rates are 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} for the trainable student blocks and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for the remaining parameters.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare SCRiD with 10 representative methods: DeMamba [ 4 ] , D3 [ 39 ] , STALL [ 1 ] , ReStraV [ 11 ] , CoCoDetect [ 6 ] , Native Scale [ 17 ] , NSG-VD [ 38 ] , STREAM [ 41 ] , SPLIT [ 10 ] , and EFFORT [ 35 ] . These methods span diverse detection strategies, including temporal statistics, spatial and temporal likelihoods, pretrained visual representations, and learning approaches based on different forensic cues.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the comparison of SCRiD with ten representative detectors across six benchmarks. SCRiD achieves the highest average ACC of 72.72% and AP of 74.23%, outperforming the strongest baselines by 3.24 and 0.81 percentage points (pp), respectively. These improvements are statistically significant across five runs according to a two-sided paired t t -test ( p = 0.00038 p=0.00038 for ACC and p = 0.0319 p=0.0319 for AP). The corresponding 95% confidence intervals for the performance gains are [2.42, 4.06] and [0.11, 1.51] pp, respectively. Its advantage is also reflected in the individual benchmarks, where SCRiD ranks first or second in ten of the twelve metrics. Specifically, SCRiD achieves the best results in both metrics on ComGenVid and RA-Bench by improving ACC by 4.00 and 1.86 pp over the strongest competing methods, respectively. It also obtains the highest AP of 93.62% on AIGVDBench and the highest ACC of 66.63% on ViF-Bench. Notably, the improvements extend across benchmarks with different generation sources and video distributions, demonstrating the strong generalization capability of SCRiD. Furthermore, SCRiD maintains competitive performance even when ACC and AP exhibit different trends. For instance, although DeMamba achieves higher ACC on AIGVDBench, SCRiD surpasses it by 3.07 pp in AP. Overall, these results demonstrate that incorporating spatial correspondence and contextual consistency enables SCRiD to capture transferable detection evidence across diverse unseen generators and video content.

Compared with the baseline, MCR improves the average ACC and AP by 7.36 and 6.47 pp, respectively, while RCSA yields gains of 2.92 and 2.44 pp. Combining both components further increases ACC and AP to 69.91% and 71.22%, indicating that spatial correspondence and contextual consistency provide complementary detection evidence. blocks.en: Table 3 further examines the key design choices. For MCR, replacing matched coordinate responses with conventional flow-aligned residuals reduces ACC and AP by 3.08 and 1.87 pp, respectively, while removing content modulation leads to larger drops of 6.91 and 4.12 pp. These results highlight the importance of spatial reference comparisons and content guidance in residual modeling. For RCSA, freezing the randomly initialized noise predictor decreases ACC and AP by 4.06 and 1.62 pp, demonstrating the contribution of the learned conditional denoising reference. Allowing classification gradients to update the noise predictor further reduces AP by 4.37 pp, despite a relatively small ACC drop of 0.58 pp. This suggests that keeping the authentic video reference independent of classification supervision is important for preserving its effectiveness. For REE, replacing the symplectic updates with a parameter-matched residual MLP reduces ACC and AP by 1.72 and 2.32 pp, while adopting reversible coupling without symplecticity causes larger drops of 4.55 and 4.81 pp. These findings support the effectiveness of the proposed structured evidence exchange beyond conventional feature interaction and reversibility alone.

To evaluate the robustness of SCRiD, we apply 7 types of postprocessing perturbations to videos from ViF-Bench, ComGenVid, and GenBuster, including Gaussian blur ( σ = 1 \sigma=1 ), resizing ( × 0.5 \times 0.5 ), Gaussian noise ( σ = 2 \sigma=2 ), gamma correction ( γ = 0.8 \gamma=0.8 and 1.2 1.2 ), saturation and contrast adjustments (both × 0.5 \times 0.5 ), and JPEG compression ( Q = 75 Q=75 ). We report the average ACC across the three benchmarks and the mean accuracy drop relative to clean videos, treating the two gamma settings as one perturbation type.
Table 4 shows the robustness evaluation results. SCRiD achieves the highest ACC across all perturbation settings, maintaining an average of 74.24% compared with 75.00% on clean videos. Its mean performance drop is only 0.76 pp, with the largest reduction of 1.15 pp occurring under saturation adjustment. Although ReStraV and STREAM exhibit smaller average drops of 0.22 and 0.52 pp, their absolute ACC values remain substantially lower than those of SCRiD. In contrast, CoCoDetect suffers a 3.20 pp drop under Gaussian blur, while EFFORT experiences a pronounced reduction of 11.25 pp under JPEG compression. These results demonstrate that SCRiD preserves strong detection accuracy with limited degradation under diverse post-processing operations.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we propose SCRiD, a reference-informed framework for generalizable AI-generated video detection that interprets video discrepancies through spatial correspondence and contextual consistency. Specifically, we introduce MCR to characterize temporal residual associations under motion and coordinate references, and develop RCSA to learn a conditional denoising reference from authentic videos for capturing content-dependent feature variations. We further design REE to integrate these complementary representations through reversible symplectic evidence exchange. Extensive experiments across 6 benchmarks demonstrate the strong generalization capability of SCRiD, achieving average ACC and AP of 72.72% and 74.23%, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of the proposed components, while robustness evaluations demonstrate stable detection performance under common post-processing operations. Overall, these results highlight the effectiveness of interpreting video variations through complementary references for detecting videos generated by unseen methods.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出SCRID,这是通用AI生成的视频检测的参考信息框架,通过空间通信与上下文一致性来解释视频差异. 具体地说,我们采用MCR来描述运动中的时间残余关联和协调参考,并发展RCSA来从真实视频中学习有条件的去命名参考,以获取内容依赖的特性变化. 我们进一步设计REE,通过可逆的同声交换证据来整合这些互补的表示. 跨越6个基准的广泛实验表明,SCRID具有强大的通用能力,平均ACC和AP分别达到72.72%和74.23%. 差异研究验证了拟议组成部分的贡献,而稳健性评价显示,在共同的后处理业务中,检测工作表现稳定。 总体而言,这些结果凸显出通过补充参考对视频变化进行解释的有效性,以检测由看不见的方法生成的视频.

blocks.en:
We compare SCRiD with ten representative methods for AI-generated content detection, including DeMamba [ 4 ] , D3 [ 39 ] , STALL [ 1 ] , ReStraV [ 11 ] , CoCoDetect [ 6 ] , Native Scale [ 17 ] , NSG-VD [ 38 ] , STREAM [ 41 ] , SPLIT [ 10 ] ,
and EFFORT [ 35 ] .
These methods cover diverse detection strategies, ranging from temporal inconsistency analysis and forensic artifact modeling to pretrained visual representations and training-free detection.
A brief introduction to each baseline is provided as follows:

我们比较了SCRID与AI生成的内容检测的十种代表性方法,包括德曼巴[4],D3 [39],STALL [1],ReStraV [11],CoCo Detect [6],土著比例 [17],NSG-VD [38],STREAM [41],SPLIT [10],
[35]。
这些方法涵盖各种探测策略,从时间不一致分析和法证文物模型化到预先训练的视觉表现和无训练的探测.

blocks.en: • DeMamba [ 4 ] : It employs Mamba-based sequence modeling on local visual features to capture spatial and temporal inconsistencies in generated videos, while incorporating global representations for classification. • D3 [ 39 ] : This training-free method exploits second-order temporal differences in pretrained visual representations to identify irregular dynamics in AI-generated videos. • STALL [ 1 ] : It combines spatial and temporal likelihood scores derived from pretrained video features and authentic-video statistics, enabling detection without training on generated samples. • ReStraV [ 11 ] : Inspired by perceptual straightening, ReStraV measures temporal curvature and stepwise distances in pretrained feature space to characterize differences between real and generated video trajectories. • CoCoDetect [ 6 ] : This framework learns discriminative spatiotemporal representations through contrastive learning on semantically aligned real-fake video pairs. A confidence-gated mechanism further employs multimodal language model reasoning for uncertain predictions. • Native Scale [ 17 ] : It processes videos at their native spatial resolutions using a vision-language backbone, preserving high-frequency forgery artifacts and spatiotemporal inconsistencies that may be lost during conventional resizing and cropping. • NSG-VD [ 38 ] : Based on probability flow conservation, it characterizes video dynamics using normalized spatiotemporal gradients and measures their distributional discrepancies from authentic videos. • STREAM [ 41 ] : STREAM exploits I-frames, motion vectors, and residual information from compressed video bitstreams to efficiently capture spatial and temporal forgery artifacts. • SPLIT [ 10 ] : It provides training-free detection by combining two-step temporal roughness and local spatial motion incoherence extracted from frozen patch-level visual representations. • EFFORT [ 35 ] : It decomposes pretrained representations into orthogonal subspaces and selectively adapts complementary components to capture forgery patterns while preserving pretrained knowledge.

blocks.en: We compare the computational efficiency of SCRiD with existing detectors in terms of both inference and training. Table 5 reports model size, computational cost, latency, and memory usage during inference, together with training time, throughput, and peak memory for trainable methods.
blocks.zh: 我们从推论和培训两个方面将SCRID的计算效率与现有的探测器进行比较. 表5报告模型大小、计算成本、耐久性和推论期间的内存使用,以及培训时间、吞吐量和可培训方法的峰值内存。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 5 , SCRiD achieves a favorable balance between detection performance and computational efficiency. Firstly, SCRiD maintains a compact model size of 27.22M parameters, low peak inference memory of 0.26 GiB, and practical inference latency of 23.76 ms. Compared with recent high-performing baselines such as EFFORT and DeMamba, SCRiD is substantially more efficient in both memory usage and inference latency while delivering stronger detection performance. In particular, SCRiD uses far fewer parameters and less inference memory than EFFORT, and it also reduces both inference and end-to-end latency relative to DeMamba.
SCRiD is also efficient during training. It requires 5.89 hours of training, achieves a throughput of 10.76 videos/s, and uses 6.83 GiB peak training memory. This training cost is markedly lower than that of several competitive baselines, including CoCoDetect, Native Scale, NSG-VD, and DeMamba. Overall, these results show that SCRiD not only brings clear performance gains over prior detectors, but also preserves a highly practical efficiency profile, making it attractive for real-world deployment.

blocks.en: We analyze the sensitivity of several key hyperparameters in SCRiD. Specifically, we vary one hyperparameter at a time while keeping the others fixed at their default settings. Figure 4 illustrates the influence of four key hyperparameters. The star markers in Figure 4 correspond to the adopted default settings in the main experiments. For the coordinate offset radius r r in MCR, increasing r r from 1 to 4 gradually reduces ACC, while AP exhibits some variation, suggesting that a wider spatial reference does not consistently improve detection. The denoising loss weight λ \lambda has a relatively limited influence, with both metrics remaining competitive across the tested settings. For the noise scaling factor s s , the default value s = 2 s=2 achieves the highest ACC of 72.72%, while both smaller and larger scales generally lead to lower accuracy, indicating the importance of selecting an appropriate noise scale. The number of REE exchange layers L L exhibits a nonmonotonic trend. Although L = 5 L=5 achieves the highest ACC and AP of 73.09% and 75.64%, respectively, the default setting L = 3 L=3 provides competitive performance with fewer layers. Overall, these results indicate that SCRiD maintains reasonable stability across different hyperparameter settings, with the adopted configuration offering a favorable balance between detection performance and model complexity.

REE交换层LL的数量呈现出非通量趋势. 虽然L=5 L=5分别达到73.09%和75.64%的最高ACC和AP,但默认设置L=3 L=3提供了较少分层的竞争性业绩. 总体而言,这些结果表明,SCRID在不同超参数设置上保持了合理的稳定性,所采用的配置在检测性能和模型复杂性之间提供了有利的平衡.

blocks.en: Visualization of Denoising Reference. Figure 5 visualizes how the conditional noise predictor corrects perturbed features before and after denoising training. The dashed and solid contours represent feature coverage before and after correction, respectively, while the star marks the clean reference. The randomly initialized predictor produces little correction, with the two sets of contours largely overlapping. After training, the corrected features move closer to the clean reference, as reflected by the contraction of the solid contours. This behavior is observed for both authentic and generated videos, indicating that RCSA learns an effective denoising reference that provides a basis for subsequent probing of feature responses.

blocks.en: Feature Similarity under Blur. Figure 6 compares the pairwise cosine similarities of centered video features before and after Gaussian blurring. Each method is evaluated using four similarity matrices corresponding to authentic and generated video pairs, where red and blue indicate higher and lower similarities, respectively. Under blurring, ReStraV exhibits irregular similarity patterns across both same-class and different-class pairs, making their distinctions less apparent. CoCoDetect and EFFORT show broadly increased similarities across different class combinations, weakening the distinction between authentic and generated features. In comparison, SCRiD maintains relatively high similarities within each class and lower similarities between classes, preserving clearer class-related feature structure under visual degradation.

blocks.en: Mechanism Analysis of MCR. Figure 7 illustrates how MCR compares temporal residual associations under the motion and coordinate references. Starting from the same location in the source frame, the motion reference samples the subsequent residual along the estimated motion, while the coordinate reference samples near the original image coordinates. As shown in the figure, the motion-sampled residual exhibits stronger agreement with the source residual, yielding a normalized mismatch of 0.18 compared with 1.03 under the coordinate reference. This difference is further captured by the MCR distance response, which highlights variations in residual agreement between the two spatial references. These observations demonstrate how MCR converts spatial correspondence information into local temporal evidence.
blocks.zh: MCR机制分析. 图7说明了磁共振中心如何在运动下比较时间上剩余协会并协调参考。 从源框的同一位置开始,运动参考物沿着估计的运动来取样后续的残留物,而坐标参考物则取自靠近原始图像坐标的样本. 如图所显示的,运动取样后残留物与源残留物的一致程度更强,导致正常的错配率为0.18,而坐标下为1.03。 这一差异进一步被MCR相距反应所反映出,它凸显出两个空间参考物之间残留协议的差异. 这些观测表明MCR如何将空间函证信息转化为当地时间证据.

blocks.en: Mechanism Analysis of RCSA. Figure 8 illustrates how RCSA converts conditional denoising responses into feature corrections. For the selected region, symmetric perturbations are applied to its projected feature, and the conditional noise predictor produces corresponding predictions based on the surrounding video context. These predictions are combined to obtain shift and sensitivity responses across three noise scales, capturing the denoising correction and its variation along the probing direction. The aggregated responses are subsequently decoded into feature corrections. As shown in the figure, the correction magnitudes vary across spatial regions, while the selected region exhibits both positive and negative adjustments across feature channels. These observations illustrate how RCSA uses the learned conditional denoising reference to guide the adaptation of visual representations.
blocks.zh: 区域协调机制分析。 图8说明了RCSA如何将有条件的去名答复转化为特征更正。 对于所选区域,对称扰动被应用于其预测特征,有条件的噪声预测器根据周围的视频上下文产生相应的预测. 这些预测结合起来,在三个噪声尺度上获得变化和敏感反应,捕捉到去诺的校正及其沿探险方向的变化. 汇总的答复随后被解码为特征更正。 如图所显示的,各空间区域的校正幅度各不相同,而选定的区域则在各种特征渠道上表现出正反两方面的调整。 这些意见说明了RCSA如何利用学到的有条件去名的参考来指导视觉表现的改编.

blocks.en: Mechanism Analysis of REE. Figure 9 illustrates how REE enables information exchange between the MCR and RCSA evidence streams. Before interaction, the MCR representation is shared across spatial regions within each frame, while the RCSA representation retains regional variations. Through reversible exchange layers, the two coupled states influence each other, producing updates in both representations. As shown in the figure, the initially identical MCR features acquire distinct regional patterns after three exchange layers, reflecting the incorporation of regional information from RCSA. These observations demonstrate how REE facilitates bidirectional evidence interaction while enriching the representations of the two streams.
blocks.zh: REE机制分析. 图9说明了REE如何在MCR和RCSA证据流之间交流信息。 在互动之前,每个框架内的磁共振代表由空间区域共享,而磁共振代表则保留区域差异。 通过可逆的交换层,两个相接的状态互相影响,在两种表述中产生更新. 如图所示,最初相同的MCR特征在三个交换层之后获得了不同的区域模式,反映了从RCSA中获取的区域信息。 这些意见表明REE如何促进双向证据互动,同时丰富两个流的表述.

blocks.en: Mechanism Analysis of Symplectic Updates. Figure 10 further examines the directional behavior of the symplectic updates in REE. While the symplectic condition preserves the volume and recoverability of the joint representation, it allows different directions to undergo distinct transformations. As shown in Figure 10 (a), feature variations with the same initial magnitude exhibit progressive expansion or contraction across successive exchange layers. To assess their relevance to the final prediction, we measure readout sensitivity by the percentage change in the classification output under equal-magnitude feature perturbations. An isotropic reference is constructed using perturbations of the same magnitude. Figure 10 (b) further shows that the directions with pronounced rescaling exhibit higher classification sensitivity than this isotropic reference. These observations illustrate how the structured symplectic updates enable nonuniform directional adjustments during evidence exchange, with the strongly affected directions also contributing to the final prediction.

Mattle Analysis of Symplectic Updates. 图10进一步考察了REE中同义词更新的方向行为. 虽然同位素条件保留了联合代表的体积和可回收性,但允许不同的方向进行不同的转变. 如图10(a)所显示,初始规模相同的特征变化在相继的交换层中逐渐扩大或收缩。 为了评估它们与最后预测的相关性,我们用等宽度特征扰动下分类产出的百分比变化来衡量读出敏感性。 使用同样规模的扰动构建了异地参照. 图10(b)还显示,有分级分级的取向显示的分类灵敏度高于这种异热带参考。 这些观察表明,结构化的同位素更新如何在证据交换过程中促成非统一方向调整,而受严重影响的方向也有助于最终预测。
